description: Read health and fitness data from your users' wearables through Terra (Garmin, Oura, Fitbit, WHOOP, Polar and more): send connection links, manage connections, get workouts, sleep, daily totals, body metrics and nutrition, and plan workouts onto their devices.

terra_new_activity_trigger.description: Runs for each new workout a connected person's wearable records, such as a run or a ride, with its type, distance, calories and heart rate. Workouts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Checks every five minutes or less often, as your workspace plan allows.

output.activity: The whole workout record as Terra gives it.
output.activity_type: Terra's number for the kind of workout (8 is running).
output.avg_heart_rate: Average heart rate, beats per minute.
output.max_heart_rate: Highest heart rate, beats per minute.
output.name: The workout's name, such as Morning Run.
output.provider: Their wearable or app, such as GARMIN or OURA.
output.reference_id: Your own ID for the person, given when they connected.
output.terra_user_id: The person's Terra user ID, for other Terra steps.

parameters.description: Optional. Only this person's connection. Leave blank to watch everyone connected, up to 25 people.
parameters.name: terra_user_id

terra_new_daily_summary_trigger.description: Runs once a connected person's day has ended, with that day's steps, distance, calories, active time and resting heart rate. Days already over when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Checks every five minutes or less often, as your workspace plan allows.

output.daily: The whole daily summary as Terra gives it.
output.provider: Their wearable or app, such as GARMIN or OURA.
output.reference_id: Your own ID for the person, given when they connected.
output.resting_heart_rate: Resting heart rate, beats per minute.
output.terra_user_id: The person's Terra user ID, for other Terra steps.

parameters.description: Optional. Only this person's connection. Leave blank to watch everyone connected, up to 25 people.
parameters.name: terra_user_id

terra_new_sleep_trigger.description: Runs for each night's sleep (or nap) a connected person's wearable records, once it has ended, with time asleep, deep, light and REM sleep. Sleep already there when the workflow is turned on doesn't start it. Checks every five minutes or less often, as your workspace plan allows.

output.efficiency: Share of time in bed spent asleep.
output.is_nap: True for a nap rather than the main sleep.
output.provider: Their wearable or app, such as GARMIN or OURA.
output.reference_id: Your own ID for the person, given when they connected.
output.resting_heart_rate: Resting heart rate, beats per minute.
output.sleep: The whole sleep record as Terra gives it.
output.terra_user_id: The person's Terra user ID, for other Terra steps.

parameters.description: Optional. Only this person's connection. Leave blank to watch everyone connected, up to 25 people.
parameters.name: terra_user_id

terra_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when someone connects a wearable or health app to your Terra account, with their Terra user ID, your reference ID and the provider. Checks as often as your workspace plan allows.

output.provider: Their wearable or app, such as GARMIN or OURA.
output.reference_id: Your own ID for the person, given when they connected.
output.scopes: The kinds of data they agreed to share.
output.terra_user_id: The person's Terra user ID, for other Terra steps.

terra_user_disconnected_trigger.description: Runs when a connection ends: someone disconnects their wearable, removes access in its app, or is disconnected through Terra. Gives the details the connection had. Checks as often as your workspace plan allows.

output.provider: Their wearable or app, such as GARMIN or OURA.
output.reference_id: Your own ID for the person, given when they connected.
output.scopes: The kinds of data they agreed to share.
output.terra_user_id: The person's Terra user ID, for other Terra steps.
